#*Question:** Probability of hitting target is 0.3 Find probability of missing at least once in 3 sh
common_mistakes.user_comment:
P(miss at least once) = 1 - P(hit all three)
= 1 - (0.3)³
= 1 - 0.027 = 0.973

**Answer:** 0.973
